rationale: The previous candidate performed excellently with no line loss events and very low RMS error and steering oscillation, indicating stable control and good line following. The evaluator suggested increasing kd to 5 to add more damping if oscillations persist, reverting line_loss to 'search_left' if line loss events increase, and reducing kp to 4 if oscillations increase. I have implemented these suggestions: reduced kp from 5 to 4 to slightly reduce proportional gain and potential oscillations, increased kd from 4 to 6 to provide stronger damping, and reverted line_loss to 'search_left' to maintain the previously successful recovery strategy. I also kept base_speed at 1.6 to maintain the improved pace from the last iteration. The geometry and sensor layout remain unchanged as they are already effective. I expect these changes to further reduce steering oscillations and maintain zero line loss events, improving overall stability and potentially improving completion time and progress. I request the same measurements as before to verify these effects.
